title: Expand a conversational tool loop under a tools graph node
narrative: Fangore binds the library conversational tool-loop recipe so a chat tools step grows nested rounds — model complete then per-tool calls — inside the tools node’s checkpoint without pre-creating empty max-turn slots. A stop contract bounds the loop. Complements `fangore_insp_stop_contract`, `fangore_node_components`, and `fangore_host_kit_event_tap`.[^june-hf07]
implementation: Agentic Recipe catalog id `conversational_tool_loop` (`ConversationalToolLoopTemplate`). `ConversationalToolLoopRunner` expands `tools.subgraph` with nested `inference` and `tool_call` graph nodes per round. Soft points cover runner kinds, stop/max_iterations, message state, inference and tool dispatch. Bounds use existing `StopContract` / repeating fields.
validation: Harness `harness_runs` op `conversational_tool_loop` → `_run_conversational_tool_loop`. Soft expects: status ok; subgraph has inference and tool_call node ids; rounds ≥ 1. Unit: `tests/test_conversational_tool_loop.py`.
